arch.already_collected: ✅ This fossil has already been collected.
arch.bureau_howto:
1️⃣ Pick a site below
2️⃣ Dig through the rock to reach the fossil
3️⃣ Keep integrity above **0%** to extract a quality fossil
arch.bureau_pick: Choose a dig site below to start your expedition!
arch.cursed_debuff: ⚠️ *Cursed artifact weighs on you , +10% risk on all actions*
arch.cursed_msg: 🔮 **Cursed Artifact!** You uncover an ancient relic pulsing with dark energy. It feels wrong...
arch.damaged_msg: 😬 **Extraction completed, but...** The fossil is badly damaged.
arch.disaster_msg: 💀 **Disaster!** The fossil was completely destroyed. Only Bone Dust remains.
arch.error: ❌ Something went wrong with the excavation.
arch.event_cavein_abandon_desc: You flee the site as the tunnel collapses behind you. Better luck next time.
arch.event_cavein_careful_desc: You brace the tunnel and wait for the tremors to pass. You lose some time, but you are safe.
arch.event_cavein_desc:
The tunnel trembles violently! Rocks fall from above!
*A collapse is imminent!*
arch.event_cavein_rush_desc: You dig frantically through the chaos, making progress but damaging the fossil!
arch.event_default_desc: The earth shifts beneath your feet. Something is different now.
arch.event_egg_desc: You uncover what looks like a fossilized egg! Ancient patterns cover its surface.
arch.event_egg_result_desc: You carefully place the egg in your pack. It feels... warm.
arch.event_guardian_desc: A spectral figure materializes before you! It guards something precious beneath the fossil!
arch.event_guardian_press_desc: The guardian lashes out! You save the fossil but it takes damage.
arch.event_guardian_retreat_desc: You bow respectfully and step back. The guardian fades into the rock.
arch.event_guardian_tribute_desc: You place coins as tribute. The guardian nods and grants you extra time. +1 action!
arch.event_treasure_desc: Your tool strikes something metallic! Ancient coins spill from the dirt!
arch.event_treasure_dig_desc: You pocket the ancient coins! A nice bonus for your trouble.
arch.event_treasure_ignore_desc: You ignore the treasure and refocus on the fossil. Professional.
arch.event_whisper_desc:
The rock murmurs softly, as if guiding your hand. It wants to give up its secrets.
*You sense which tool will work best here.*
arch.event_whisper_result_desc:
You adjust your grip. The rock's secrets are clearer now.

💡 **The whisper reveals:** {tool} is most effective in {layer}!
arch.journal_msg: 📄 You find a torn page from an ancient excavator's journal. Another piece of the puzzle...
arch.keep_desc:
You carefully store the {item} in your collection bag.
{xp}
arch.limit_reached: ⛏️ You've exhausted your daily digs. Rest and return tomorrow!
arch.living_msg: 🧬 **LIVING FOSSIL!** The fossil's eye... just moved. You cradle a prehistoric egg that still carries a spark of life!
arch.no_money: ❌ You don't have enough coins for this site!
arch.reanimate_cmd_invalid: ❌ Invalid rarity! Valid: common, rare, epic, legendary, pure_dna
arch.reanimate_cmd_usage:
❌ Usage: `!reanimate <rarity>`
Rarities: common, rare, epic, legendary, pure_dna
arch.reanimate_fail_desc: 3 of your fossils crumble to dust. The spark of life was not enough... You keep 2.
arch.reanimate_success_desc:
The 5 fossil fragments assemble and pulse with life...
Congratulations, you obtained a **{pet}**!
arch.scan_feedback: 📡 Scan complete. The layer's secrets are revealed!
arch.session_expired: ❌ Your dig session has expired. Start a new excavation with /dig!
arch.shadow_msg: 🖤 **Shadow Fossil!** A fossil of pure darkness emerges from the rock. It pulses with an unnatural energy!
arch.site_cliffside_desc: 🟧 **Cliffside (Free)** , Moderate depth. Mixed rock types. Rare to epic fossils.
arch.site_fault_desc: 🟥 **Seismic Fault ($200)** , Hard bedrock and dangerous gravel. Contains Legendary T-Rex fragments!
arch.site_ice_sheet_desc: 🟦 **Ice Sheet ($50, Lvl 3)** , Frozen ground. Rare fossils and Pure DNA chance.
arch.site_locked: ❌ This site is locked! Raise your Archeologist level to unlock it.
arch.site_riverbed_desc: 🟩 **Riverbed (Free)** , Shallow, easy digs. Soft soil and gravel. Common to rare fossils.
arch.site_volcanic_desc: ⬛ **Volcanic Tuff ($100, Lvl 5)** , Extreme depth. Bedrock layers. Epic to Legendary fossils and Pure DNA.
arch.sold_desc: You sell the fossil to a visiting collector for a premium price of **${coins}**!
arch.time_afternoon: ☀️ *The midday sun beats down on the dusty earth.*
arch.time_evening: 🌆 *Golden hour paints the excavation in warm amber light.*
arch.time_morning: 🌅 *Dawn breaks over the dig site. Fresh energy fills the air.*
arch.time_night: 🌙 *Moonlight casts long shadows across the excavation.*
arch.tip_1: 🖌️ The Brush never damages fossils. Use it on delicate layers like clay and soft soil!
arch.tip_2: 🔨 The Hammer is your all-rounder. Effective on most rock types with moderate risk.
arch.tip_3: 🧨 Dynamite is powerful but risky. Reserve it for Bedrock layers.
arch.tip_4: 📡 Use Scan to reveal layer composition before choosing your tool.
arch.tip_5: 🖤 Ancient darkness hides where hope is nearly lost... very low integrity can reveal rare finds.
arch.tip_6: 🧬 Perfect extraction with the Brush may uncover living fossils!
arch.tip_7: 📄 Lost Journal pages are scattered across dig sites. Collect all 8 for a special reward.
arch.tip_8: 🌋 Higher-level sites unlock at Archeologist level 3 and 5. Keep digging to progress!
